warnings.message: npm is not pinned for the repository, and npm 11.16.0 (which Node.js 24.18.0 in frontend/.nvmrc comes with) runs dependency install scripts that allowScripts does not cover unless strict-allow-scripts is set, so depcurfew apply writes strict-allow-scripts=true; with it, in npm 12.0.0 and later the install fails instead of blocking the script with a warning
warnings.fix: Pin one npm version (packageManager or devEngines) to configure for it alone; with strict-allow-scripts, review the packages an install stops at and add them to installScripts.allow or installScripts.deny in depcurfew.json

warnings.message: npm 11.15.0 (which frontend/Dockerfile installs on line 3) runs every dependency install script and has no allow-list, so "deny" cannot be enforced there
warnings.fix: Install npm 11.16.0 or later before packages are installed there (npm install -g npm@11.16.0), or move to a Node.js release that comes with it; npm 12 blocks dependency scripts by default
